coreIdea: Min FFs for mod-N = ⌈log2(N)⌉. Johnson counter: n FFs → 2n states. Ring counter: n FFs → n states. Max freq = 1/(critical path delay+setup).
mustRememberFormulas: Ring counter: n flip-flops → n states
Max clock frequency = 1/(critical path propagation delay + setup time)

commonTrapsQuickList: Johnson/ring counters have DIFFERENT state-count formulas than standard log2(N) binary counters
Critical path for max-frequency must include combinational logic between FF stages, not just FF delay alone
Saturating counters have special boundary behavior — verify hold-vs-wrap explicitly
Different flip-flop types (D/JK/T) in one circuit need their own excitation tables applied correctly
